scope: Exact prior manifest-derived proof/raw/failure closure plus compact full2 successor and launch/terminal preservation; no directory-wide history or build corpus. Full1 STOP files are unchanged. Final full2 independent review path will be added once saved.
source_dependencies: Build receipts/objects/logs retained under .build with exact hashes in validation/oracles/transfer; installed provider/tool inputs remain named reproducibility dependencies of accepted historical proof.
not_acceptance: Accepted only scoped direct ownership correction/current maintained validation. Changed Workspace/Traversal eligibility and globalP08/unit/live/profile/resource gates remain OPEN. Root alone stages/commits.

self_handling.reason: A file cannot contain its own cryptographic content hash without recursion; final scope SHA is reported externally to root, and approved path-list SHA below binds its inclusion.

historical_manifest_handling: Full1 STOP records/review remain byte-identical. Historical before/source-freeze hashes are snapshots, preserved in before copies; current full2 scope rows bind current metadata after root doc-only acceptance update.

approved_stage_paths.format: One exact repository-relative path per line;62sources +finite evidence +scope itself; no directory patterns/unrelated files.
